hypothesis: Reuse exactly equal conditioning-prefix rows for native MoE and its shared/router projections only; attention, GDN, backbone dense projections and teacher computation keep full rows.
isolated_variable: Only DRAMA3_MIXED_ROW_REUSE 0 to 1 on the same frozen production commit.
quality_scope: Both complete unfiltered 1088 scores against same-C64 vLLM bounds: WER +1 percentage point, SIM -2. No outlier clipping or drain exclusion.

continuation.requires: Both complete quality gates plus candidate frames/s >= 1.01 * control frames/s and actual candidate activation coverage > 0.
continuation.after_pass: Report to root before separately frozen 3 paired rounds; never automatically repeat.
continuation.after_fail: Stop promotion and additional rounds; preserve full results.

sampling: Candidate prebuilds five extra graphs. Sampling step is neither instrumented nor reset; initialization and subsequent admission schedules may change generated frames/audio. This is an end-to-end service feasibility pair, not a fixed-output or replicated speedup claim.
codec_policy: Both arms use native DP. Each startup measures its own codec cost table; partitions are not frozen. Async private capture/thread remains identical.
startup_memory: Process-to-readiness includes load/capture/warmup. One-second GPU process polling reports observed startup and steady peaks, not exact allocator peaks or transient capture allocations. No downloads, cache flushes, clock changes, or profiler.
coverage: Shutdown row_reuse_counts include all server lifetime work: 64 concurrency-warmup requests plus 1088 measured requests. They are not benchmark-only. Report opportunities/used/unsupported/no-fit/removed rows; reject zero activation as inconclusive.
mapping_cpu: mapping_cpu_ms and maximum cover planning and prompt snapshots only. Prepare byte-binding validation and map H2D upload are excluded from this counter but included in measured end-to-end service latency.
tail: Metrics include all requests and full drain. Report last dispatch to last completion, frames/chunks emitted after last dispatch, and active-request time integral separately; these client timestamps do not imply GPU causal spans.
ownership: Selected GPU must be empty before each arm. Poll once/sec; abort on any observed unowned process/query error. SIGTERM the owned run_baseline runner and let its finally clean the server; only recorded PID+starttime identities may receive cleanup signals. Never signal foreign jobs.
stop: Any source/hash/exact/ownership/server/incomplete-result failure stops, preserving artifacts. Complete quality is still required after a numerically valid throughput-negative pair.
